scope: Explicit Git sharing for document review notes only; no platform phase acceptance.

tests.environment: Native Windows Node and disposable Git repositories with local bare remotes

coverage: Latest draft is saved before sharing, including an in-flight write
Only the detected reviewer's note file is committed
Unrelated staged files remain staged and other reviewer files remain local
Unrelated outgoing commits, wrong branch, stale revision and remote divergence are rejected
Commit hooks remain active; hook rejection never pushes
Committed notes match the confirmed save, allowing only CRLF normalization
Hook changes to staged text or invalid UTF-8 are rejected before pushing
Different or multiple destinations and Git URL rewrites are rejected
Failed pushes can retry without a duplicate commit
Repeated sharing without edits does not create another commit
Transient autosave failures preserve retry scheduling
Existing identity, draft, Markdown, lock and embedded asset checks remain passing

artifact.notesChecker: Both reviewer files valid; earlier version attribution preserved

independentReview.result: All five reported findings repaired and closed by source inspection. Regression tests passed in the parent run.
independentReview.limitations: Independent reviewer did not execute backend Git fixtures. Browser rendering and native macOS behavior remain unverified.

repositoryPatternCheck.error: Review is stale or missing: inspect changes and refresh sourceDigest
repositoryPatternCheck.reason: Concurrent delivery audit, tracking and native P01 evidence changes require their owning review. The notes-tool review does not accept those changes or update the global digest.

sharingAuthorization: An explicit Share notes click is required. Notes remain feedback, not implementation, merge or release approval.
